title: Sega Rally Championship
provenance: Reported by jaykup2 (highball-db#1397, 2026-11-22), Apple A18 Pro, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, DXVK, rated 3 of 5 after 7 minutes: named RALLY in the report, the PC version, with both its software rendering version and the Direct3D patch tried, and the steam and vcrun2022 recipes in the environment. The copy's source isn't stated. Both versions draw the game in the bottom right corner of the screen. The Direct3D version runs extremely slowly, at times a frame at a time. The software version runs at full speed without the frame pacing trouble the game has on modern Windows, with a white flashing line above the picture that a 320x240 resolution removes, which leaves a very small picture. Sound effects play and the music doesn't, since the game plays it as CD audio, which the player suggests _inmm in the game's folder might fix. Played through the Desert course in Arcade Mode. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Sega's rally game, its PC version, which isn't on Steam. Reported playable with workarounds on an A18 Pro in DXVK mode on the Wine 10 engine r29 over 7 minutes: the software rendering version runs at full speed in the bottom right corner of the screen, without music.
